parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Range is $y>-1$. B1. FT on their $a$. Accept any equivalent notation. $y=(x-3)^2-1\Rightarrow(x-3)^2=1+y\Rightarrow x=3(\pm)\sqrt{1+y}$. M1. Order of operations correct; allow sign errors. $f^{-1}(x)=3-\sqrt{1+x}$ CAO. A1. Total: 3.
